meta.themes: Enterprise Copilots, AI Capital, Agent Tooling, Safety Partnerships

news.title: Microsoft expanded Copilot with multi-model critique and broader Cowork access
news.summary: Reuters reported Microsoft added a workflow where Copilot can combine outputs from OpenAI and Anthropic models to improve quality, while rolling out Copilot Cowork to more early-access customers.

news.title: OpenAI faced execution pressure after raising at an $852 billion valuation
news.summary: Reuters outlined how OpenAI's scale-up is increasing pressure to prioritize revenue-driving products and reduce distraction across parallel bets.

news.title: A crisis-response vendor for leading AI labs explored anti-extremism interventions
news.summary: Reuters reported ThroughLine, which works with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google on crisis routing, is developing support flows to address violent-extremism risk signals.

news.title: Nvidia's valuation multiple fell sharply as AI-spend worries widened
news.summary: Reuters said Nvidia's price-to-earnings ratio dropped to multi-year lows amid market risk-off sentiment and concerns about near-term returns on AI infrastructure spending.

news.title: OpenAI announced a $122 billion funding round
news.summary: OpenAI said it closed a major round to scale compute, model research, and enterprise deployment while pushing toward a unified agent-first product surface.

news.title: OpenAI acquired TBPN to expand AI media and builder communication
news.summary: OpenAI said the TBPN acquisition is intended to strengthen global AI dialogue while maintaining TBPN's editorial independence.

news.title: OpenAI introduced pay-as-you-go Codex pricing for business teams
news.summary: OpenAI launched Codex-only seats with usage-based billing to reduce adoption friction for engineering teams piloting coding agents.

news.title: GitHub released the Copilot SDK in public preview
news.summary: GitHub launched a multi-language SDK exposing the Copilot agent runtime so teams can embed tool use, sessions, and orchestration into their own apps.

news.title: GitHub expanded Copilot cloud agent beyond pull-request-only workflows
news.summary: GitHub added branch-first execution, implementation planning, and deeper codebase research modes for Copilot cloud agent.

news.title: GitHub made Copilot cloud agent commits signed by default
news.summary: GitHub said Copilot cloud agent now signs all commits, enabling compatibility with repositories that enforce signed-commit protections.

news.title: VS Code 1.115 improved agent workflows and background terminal handling
news.summary: The VS Code 1.115 release added better agent session restoration, SSH agent-host support, and background terminal completion signaling.

news.title: Anthropic and Australia signed an AI safety and research MOU
news.summary: Anthropic announced formal cooperation with Australia's government on safety evaluation, economic-impact data sharing, and local research partnerships.
